verdict.rationale: Gide has a dedicated Data Protection practice page explicitly covering GDPR compliance, CNIL sanctions proceedings, and personal data processing implementation, supplemented by a broader IT/Digital/Cybersecurity practice covering related tech-regulatory issues. Missing for 10: explicit mention of CCPA, India's DPDP Act or other non-EU privacy regimes, and independent corroboration (e.g., rankings/awards) specific to the data-protection practice.
